dependency_semantics: start_after gates implementation; acceptance_after gates completion; depends_on is their union. Existing F1/F3a baseline assumed.

tasks.title: Project start, library, search and demos
tasks.acceptance: Public entry/library shows loading, empty, populated, search/no-match/clear, saved-project and demo cards with previews/counts/current marker, damaged-preview fallback, list-error retry, and editable demo opening. Browsing does not mutate project revision, history, or active selection until an open action.
tasks.boundary_status: Existing BrowserStore list/load, active-project restore, and fixture open boundaries suffice; missing private presentation projection and local list loading/error/retry state. Shared route placement is coordinator-owned.

tasks.title: Project lifecycle and portable archive
tasks.acceptance: Public browser flows create without resetting other projects, open saved projects, recover durable state, import a validated archive, download and re-open a portable project copy with assets, and delete only after named confirmation with cancel/success/failure/retry behavior. Superseded asynchronous opens do not replace the newer selection. Verify durable project/asset outcomes and active-project identity.
tasks.boundary_status: Existing Session Open/RecoverWithDocument, BrowserStore list/load/delete/save/active-id, and core archive pack/unpack contracts; Runtime lacks complete private create/delete/archive-download action adapters. Project rename/duplicate are excluded because the pinned React library/menu do not offer them. No new public API assumed.

tasks.title: Workspace panels and compact drawers
tasks.acceptance: Public desktop behavior covers pinned/auto-hide/collapsed modes, bounded pointer and keyboard resize, persistence, and panel interaction. Compact behavior covers breakpoint transitions, scrim, close/Escape, focus restoration, and hidden-content focus exclusion. Panel actions do not alter document revision, history, or camera.

tasks.title: Setup guide, shared menus, shortcuts and focus
tasks.acceptance: Public UI presents five freely navigable guide stages with readiness and per-project saved state, plus command menus with viewport-safe placement, useful initial focus, outside/Escape/explicit dismissal, and focus return. Supported shortcuts work outside text entry and do not fire while editing. Light/Dark/System presentation remains consistent across entry, menu, panel, and drawer states.
